cases.name: etaf-animation-theatre-pad-stays-editable-in-small-windows
cases.purpose: The pad keeps focus, native input and its toolbar at narrow and short viewports, and a leaked session never blocks a new one.

cases.name: etaf-animation-theatre-reflows-and-fills-its-viewport
cases.purpose: The animation rail spans the viewport and all twenty panels reflow between one and four columns while controls remain mounted.

cases.name: etaf-animation-theatre-controls-and-edit-pad
cases.purpose: The twenty-panel theatre keeps stable gallery geometry and working pause, speed, frame-rate, theme and native editing controls.

cases.name: etaf-animation-interpolation-easings-and-validation
cases.purpose: Values convert over registered easings; invalid inputs signal.

cases.name: etaf-display-metrics-update-fixed-viewport-with-retained-state
cases.purpose: Reactive display metrics update on zoom even with a fixed viewport without resetting Component state.

cases.name: etaf-display-metrics-require-a-mounted-runtime
cases.purpose: A metric query outside a mounted Runtime signals the documented lifecycle error.
